test_name: Configuration Management - CM-8 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Payments-Core-051
Primary NIST family: Configuration Management (CM); evidence focus: CM-8.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: the asset inventory has two newly created ephemeral build workers awaiting nightly reconciliation. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
